package.description: A connection manager for Windows, opening SSH, SFTP, SCP, FTP, RDP and VNC through the tools you already use.

en-US.description: A connection manager for Windows, opening SSH, SFTP, SCP, FTP, RDP and VNC through the tools you already use.
en-US.longDescription:
Hostpad keeps every remote machine in one place and opens it with a double
click. It is an address book rather than another terminal: the list, the
credentials and the notes live in Hostpad, while PuTTY, WinSCP, mstsc and your
VNC viewer do the connecting.

Connections sit in nested folders, searchable across name, hostname, username
and notes. SSH jump hosts, private keys, post-login commands, Remote Desktop
screen and drive settings are real fields rather than strings smuggled into
other strings.

The list is always encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Without a master password the
vault is tied to the Windows account through DPAPI; with one it also opens on
another computer. An existing AutoPuTTY configuration can be imported,
passwords and folders included.
en-US.name: Hostpad
